tickets.title: Coordinate divorce-related financial document package
tickets.text: Compile and organize financial planning records requested for divorce-related analysis for Anika Meadowbobbin. Use only authorized documents, confirm permitted communication channels, and separate planning notes from legal advice. Coordinate with Tobin Mossbutton of Silver Marmot Legal when written authorization is on file. Gather the investment, bank, retirement, debt, and household cash‑flow records requested by Tobin Mossbutton for the pending property discussion, and deliver the package by March 14, 2025.
tickets.evidence: They agreed that the divorce financial document package will compile authorized investment, bank, retirement, debt, and household cash-flow records requested by Tobin Mossbutton for the pending property discussion by March 14, 2025.

tickets.title: Obtain Paper Otter valuation and K‑1

tickets.title: Coordinate changes to retirement and insurance
tickets.text: Coordinate any changes to Anika Meadowbobbin’s Roth IRA, term life insurance policy, and joint taxable account through authorized legal channels, working with attorney Tobin Mossbutton, and complete the updates by March 21, 2025.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s planning inventory review found Reid still listed on Anika’s Roth IRA, term life policy, and joint taxable account; any changes are to be coordinated through authorized legal channels by March 21, 2025.
